requirements.title: Strata Control and Support Plan (SCASP)
requirements.requirement: Formulation, scientific validation, and daily implementation of Strata Control and Support Plan for all underground development headings and junctions.
requirements.description: Systematic support rules approved by DGMS with mandatory rock bolt load cell monitoring.
requirements.penaltyClause: Immediate prohibition of underground workings under Section 22(3) of Mines Act 1952.

requirements.title: Standard of Ventilation & Inflammable Gas Limits
requirements.requirement: Continuous supply of fresh air not less than 6 m³/min per person employed underground; CH4 not to exceed 0.5% in general body of air and 0.75% in return airway.
requirements.description: Periodic ventilation surveys and continuous methane & carbon monoxide telemetry sensor calibration.
requirements.penaltyClause: Withdrawal of workforce and criminal prosecution under Mines Act 1952 Section 72C.

requirements.title: Opencast Bench Height, Width & Slope Stability
requirements.requirement: Bench height shall not exceed maximum digging reach of excavator; bench width shall not be less than bench height plus 3m; overall pit slope angle verified by scientific geotechnical studies.
requirements.description: Deployment of real-time Slope Stability Radar (SSR) and continuous piezometer ground water monitoring.
requirements.penaltyClause: Suspension of heavy earth moving machinery (HEMM) excavation permissions.

requirements.title: Environmental Clearance (EC) & Ambient Air Standards
requirements.requirement: Maintenance of ambient PM10 < 100 µg/m³ and PM2.5 < 60 µg/m³ at colliery boundary; installation of CAAQMS stations and continuous water mist suppression.
requirements.description: Submission of Six-Monthly Compliance Reports to Regional Office of MoEFCC and CPCB.
requirements.regulatoryAuthority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
requirements.penaltyClause: Revocation of Environmental Clearance and imposition of Environmental Compensation under NGT Act.

requirements.title: Consent to Operate (CTO) & Effluent Neutralization
requirements.requirement: Treatment and recycling of acid mine drainage (AMD); pH maintained between 6.5 and 8.5; Total Suspended Solids (TSS) < 100 mg/L before discharge into natural water bodies.
requirements.description: Operation of Oil & Grease traps and automated water quality telemetry connected to SPCB server.
requirements.regulationReference: Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act 1974 Section 25/26
requirements.penaltyClause: Closure order under Section 33A of Water Act and disconnection of industrial power supply.

requirements.title: Submission of Annual Returns (Form IV & Form V)
requirements.requirement: Mandatory annual filing of employment, production, machinery, and safety statistics to Chief Inspector of Mines and District Magistrate on or before February 20th.
requirements.description: Verification of muster rolls, wage registers, and statutory safety committee deliberations.
requirements.penaltyClause: Statutory fine and formal notice under Section 66 of Mines Act 1952.

requirements.title: HEMM Operator Safety & Collision Warning System
requirements.requirement: Installation of audio-visual alarm (AVAS), rear-view camera, proximity warning radar, and fire suppression system (FSS) on all 100T+ dumpers and hydraulic shovels.
requirements.description: Mandatory seatbelt interlocks and quarterly operator defensive driving certification.
requirements.penaltyClause: Grounding of non-compliant heavy equipment fleet.

requirements.title: Mines Creche & Occupational Health Surveillance
requirements.requirement: Provision of modern creche facility conforming to standard specifications where female workers are employed; mandatory Periodical Medical Examination (PME) every 5 years for all mine workers.
requirements.description: Pneumoconiosis and audiometric screening conducted by DGMS-certified medical practitioners.
requirements.regulationReference: Mines Creche Rules 1966 & Mines Rules 1955 Rule 29B
requirements.penaltyClause: Statutory prosecution and recovery under Labour Welfare fund regulations.

inspections.summary: Quarterly statutory surveillance of underground ventilation and strata load cells.
Comprehensive HEMM safety, dumper collision radar, and blast vibration audit.

inspectionFindings.observation: Methane reading 0.85% in return airway 4B; ducting breached.
Refuge chamber oxygen cylinder pressure 200 bar, battery backup functional.

violations.title: Methane Ingress Exceedance in District 4 Heading
violations.description: Continuous CH4 sensor recorded 0.85% (permissible: 0.5%) at return airway junction 4B. Auxiliary fan ducting found compromised.
violations.aiRecommendation: Activate emergency booster fan, evacuate Section 4 heading, and inspect intake seal integrity.

violations.title: Tension Crack on North Overburden Dump Slope
violations.description: Geotechnical survey detected 150mm tension crack along bench 3 OB dump. Dump slope angle exceeds DGMS approved 28 degrees.
violations.aiRecommendation: Halt dumping operations on North Face, re-profile slope to 24 degrees, and install slope radar.

violations.title: Deficient Rock Bolting Anchorage Testing
violations.description: Anchor load cell testing records not maintained for 45 days in Seam XVI. Random pull test revealed 30% bolts below 6-tonne anchor capacity.
violations.aiRecommendation: Replace resin capsules with quick-setting thixotropic grout and conduct 100% pull tests.

violations.title: Effluent Water pH Below Standard in Sump Discharge
violations.description: Mine discharge into Lilagar River recorded pH 5.4 (Standard: 6.5 - 8.5) due to untreated pyritic coal washery runoff.
violations.aiRecommendation: Commission automated lime-dosing plant at Main Sump No. 2.

correctiveActions.title: Overhaul Section 4 Auxiliary Ventilation & Seal Repair
correctiveActions.description: Replace 250m damaged ventilation ducting and install flameproof twin-fan auxiliary ventilation unit.
correctiveActions.remarks: New ducting delivered on site; installation underway.

correctiveActions.title: Terracing & De-stressing of North OB Dump
correctiveActions.description: Deploy 4 dozers to grade top bench and reduce overall slope angle to 22 degrees with biological turfing.
correctiveActions.remarks: Top bench pushdown complete; slope radar reading stabilized.

correctiveActions.title: Full Resin Capsule Re-anchoring & Digital Load Testing
correctiveActions.description: Re-support 80m gallery heading with high-yield steel bolts and submit digital load cell test certificate to DGMS.
correctiveActions.remarks: All 120 bolts re-installed; 100% passed 8-tonne pull test. Awaiting inspector sign-off.

alerts.title: CRITICAL: Methane Sensor Alarm in Jharia Block-II
alerts.message: CH4 exceeded 0.8% in return airway 4B. Emergency statutory protocol initiated.
